articles.title: India Weather (October 29): Hailstorm likely in Delhi-NCR, heavy rain alert in 6 states
articles.summary: Cyclone Arnab weakened after making landfall on the Andhra Pradesh coast and is expected to affect weather conditions. articles.summary: KOLKATA: The West Bengal government led by Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari on Wednesday barred future school teachers appointed by the state School Service Commission (SSC) from engaging in direct politics. articles.title: Green financing in India rises to $82 billion, but flows mostly to established sectors

articles.title_hinglish: rajanitika netritva badalane ke bavajuda bharata aura ijaraila ke dvipakshiya sanbandha kayama rahenge
articles.summary_hinglish: ijaraila-eshiya chainbara ऑpha komarsa ke adhyaksha anata barnastina-richa ke anusar, raksh, praudyogiki aura vyapara sahayoga ki ninva ke karana rajanitika parivartanon ke bavajuda bharata aura ijaraila sanbandha majabuta bane rahenge। eka sakshatkara men, unhonne gaja aura eerana se judaी kshetriya suraksha chunautiyon para charcha karate hue dvipakshiya vyapara ki matra ko tina guna karane ke lie mukta vyapara samajhaute ki sanbhavana para prakasha dala।
